correctness.rationale: PASS: With unnormalized dA and 4/π weight (1−|z|²)^3, orthogonality gives E_N=Σ_{m≥1}w_m|Σ_j exp(imθ_j)|², w_m=24/[m(m+1)(m+2)(m+3)], and a_m=m² w_m. Differentiation termwise valid since Σm²w_m<∞, Parseval yields circulant Hessian λ_k=N(A_{k,N}+A_{N−k,N}−2A_{0,N}), λ_0=0, with correct conjugate frequency pairing. a_m decreasing and discretely convex with exact first/second differences, hence all λ_k>0 and the unique minimizing one or two modes are k=floor(N/2),ceil(N/2). Hurwitz zeta sums give λmin=16π²/N−1728ζ(3)/N²+O(N^-3). Spectral Taylor gives sharp local λmin/2 on mean-zero perturbations, not a global modulus. Independently checked exact rational differences and central eigenmodes N=2..15.
